result.summary: The image shows a curved roadway with a narrow sidewalk separated by a curb and a chain-link fence. There is a lack of pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crossings, signage, or street lighting, which may compromise safety, especially at night or on the curve.

hazards.name: Lack of street lighting
hazards.description: No visible street lights, which significantly reduces pedestrian visibility and safety during nighttime.

hazards.name: Unmarked roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a curved road can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning and lane drift.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale and roadway lighting to improve visibility and security.

interventions.title: Roadway Markings
interventions.description: Add center lines and edge lines to define travel lanes and improve driver predictability on the curve.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, unmarked roadway and a sidewalk obstructed by large debris. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or pedestrian signals at this intersection, creating a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large mattress or similar debris is blocking the narrow sidewalk on the right side of the image.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are provided at this intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross an unmarked, wide roadway.

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide asphalt surface can encourage higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks across all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped curb ramps to provide accessible crossing points.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Markings
interventions.description: Apply paint to define travel lanes and potentially add a shoulder or bike lane to reduce the perceived width of the roadway and slow traffic.

result.summary: A residential one-way street with sidewalks on both sides but lacking basic crossing infrastructure at the intersection. There are no marked crosswalks, curb ramps, or traffic control devices visible for pedestrians at the foreground crossing point.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, providing no designated space for pedestrians to cross and reducing driver awareness.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: No curb ramps are visible at the intersection corners, creating significant accessibility barriers for people with mobility aids.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a lack of formal crossing infrastructure and narrow sidewalks directly adjacent to the roadway. The wide, straight road design and absence of traffic calming measures likely prioritize vehicle speed over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross the street safely.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian buffer
hazards.description: Sidewalks are narrow and lack a physical or horizontal buffer from moving traffic.

hazards.name: Vegetation overgrowth
hazards.description: Dense vegetation on the right side of the road may obscure sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at intersections to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten crossing distance and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffers
interventions.description: Incorporate a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a safety buffer.
